content:
Dev Patel: Heads up from Support on Usage Insights beta — we’re seeing repeated confusion around the “What changed?” cards calling out **token_out spikes**. Customers read it as “platform bug / billing error” vs “your responses got longer / you sent more traffic”. Can we tweak copy/UX before we widen the allowlist?

Dev Patel: Examples from the last 48h:
- Heliochat: “Token out +212% WoW” on `Endpoint=/v1/chat/completions` + `Model=llama-3.1-70b`. They thought we started charging for streaming differently. Root cause (per their eng): they doubled traffic + bumped `max_tokens` from 512 → 2048 in a rollout.
- AcmeAI eval: saw token_out spike on a route but it was mostly **retries/fallback attempts** (they hit a transient 5xx burst). They expected “token_out” to mean only *successful* outputs.
- Northstar fintech: asked why “token_out” delta is huge when “cost” delta is modest (they were shifting model mix to a cheaper variant).

Dev Patel: Ask: can “What changed?” say *why* (volume vs per-request vs retries) and link to the right lever (max_tokens / stop / retry policy / cache)? Right now it just says “Token out increased” and they open a billing ticket.

SupportBot: (auto) Added tag: usage-insights-beta | Assigned: Dev Patel

Markus Klein: +1, we got the same on a call yesterday. The phrase “token out increased” without context reads accusatory / mysterious. Customers want “did my app change?” vs “did Redwood change?”.

Evan Scott: +1. We need a support macro here. I’m currently explaining manually: total token_out = request volume * avg output length, and it can include retries depending on attribution. Would be great if UI said that.

Marissa Cole: This is helpful. Can you paste the exact text the card shows today + what comparison window we’re using? (7d vs previous 7d?)

Dev Patel: Current card copy (from customer screenshot):
“Token out increased 212% compared to previous period.”
No other breakdown. Comparison is whatever time range they chose (most are doing “Last 7 days”).

Paula Mendes: That’s consistent with what we shipped in early beta. We can improve it.
Question: do we have the data in the backend to attribute the delta to (a) request count vs (b) avg token_out/request vs (c) retries/fallbacks?

Nadia Rahman: We should, assuming the events are complete.
We already aggregate:
- `request_count` (successful)
- `attempt_count` (includes retries)
- `token_out_total` (sum across attempts, aligned to billed usage)
- we can compute `token_out_per_successful_request` and `retry_token_out`.
The confusion is legit: “token out” in cost context includes billed attempts, not just “final success response length”.

Alex Martinez: Copy suggestion (small but clearer):
Instead of “Token out increased 212%”, do:
“Total generated tokens increased 212% (mostly from higher request volume and longer responses).”
Then add a “See breakdown” link that expands:
- Requests: +98%
- Avg tokens / successful request: +41%
- Retry + fallback tokens: +12%

Dylan Brooks: UX-wise we can do an expandable row in the driver card (or a tooltip) without adding a whole new chart.
Also: show **absolute** + **per-request**. Spikes are way less scary when they see “Avg output tokens: 220 → 310”.

Chloe Martin: From backend POV: “avg tokens per request” is easy and cheap. The retries/fallback piece is the one we need to ensure is accurate in all regions (streaming route tags issue last week was a thing).

Allison Grant: +1 on being careful. If we’re going to say “retries contributed X%” we need confidence in `attempt_count` + `retry_reason` coverage.
If there’s partial data, the card should say “Some drivers may be undercounted due to delayed telemetry” (or hide that breakdown when freshness/quality flags are tripped).

Connor O'Brien: If we can land the copy change behind the beta flag quickly, we should. This is exactly the kind of confusion that turns into a support storm when we broaden.

Elliot Price: Docs side: we can add a “Why token out spiked” section + link from the card.
Short bullets:
- More requests
- Longer outputs (max_tokens, prompt style)
- Retries/fallbacks count toward billed tokens
- Streaming doesn’t change token counts, but can correlate with longer outputs
We can also add “check these levers” links (max_tokens / stop / retry policy / routing fallback settings).

Wei Chen: I can draft tooltip language that matches console terminology (“Endpoint (normalized)”, “Generated tokens”, “Billed attempts”). If we’re changing “token out” wording, we should do it consistently in the table column headers too (or keep header and change card copy only?).

Marissa Cole: Let’s keep the table header as-is for now (too many downstream references) but change the card copy + add tooltip.
Proposed tooltip text (v1):
“Token out is the total number of generated tokens billed for this endpoint/model in the selected period. It can include tokens from retries and fallback attempts.”

Dev Patel: That tooltip would deflect ~70% of the tickets, honestly.
One more request: can we avoid “increased” without a baseline? People want to know if this is volume-driven.
Even “Token out +212% (Requests +98%, Avg output +41%)” would be huge.

Paula Mendes: Sounds good. Action items:
- Dylan: can you add breakdown lines to “What changed?” card when we have request_count + avg tokens? (Even if we omit retries in v1, at least volume vs avg.)
- Nadia/Allison: confirm whether retries/fallback attribution is safe to display (or if we need a quality gate).
- Elliot/Wei/Alex: update help center copy + short “common causes” section.
We’ll route via the beta flag so we can iterate.

Dylan Brooks: Yep. I’ll open a ticket for:
1) Card copy update (“Total token out” → “Total tokens (billed)”) in the card only
2) Add Request count delta + Avg token_out/request delta
3) Add tooltip + link to docs
Will post mock copy in #design if needed.

Nadia Rahman: On retries: I’d prefer a quality gate. If `attempt_count` coverage < threshold or we have known missing tags in a region, don’t show the retries line item.

Allison Grant: Agree. We can key off the same freshness/quality flags we’re already surfacing (lag + missing route tags). If flagged, show a neutral note: “Some drivers may be incomplete.”

Alex Martinez: Also small wording tweak: “Token out” is jargon. The card can say “Generated tokens (output)”. Keep “Token out” in the table for now but add a hover definition.

Markus Klein: Please also add a recommended next step CTA that’s not sales-y. Like:
“Common levers: reduce max_tokens, add stop sequences, improve caching, review retry policy.”
Even a simple list will reduce panic.

Dev Patel: Thank you. Once we have the new copy/tooltips, I’ll update our macro and point any incoming tickets there.

Marissa Cole: Great. Dev, if you have 1–2 screenshots from those customer reports, drop them here (redact workspace names). It helps validate we’re fixing the right surface.

Dev Patel: Will do.
(reaction :thumbsup: from Dev Patel)
(reaction :+1: from Paula Mendes)
(reaction :white_check_mark: from Dylan Brooks)
